column3: According to flesh is not expressed.
“Only” is supplied; circumcision and uncircumcision are rendered as people.
Being in circumcision or uncircumcision is rendered as after or before circumcision.
The purpose of being father is rendered as “he is the father.”
“The promise” supplies the subject; “Abraham’s” specifies the offspring.
“He is our father” repeats the preceding clause; calling what is not as existing is rendered as calling it into being.
“Abraham” supplies the subject; the purpose of becoming father is rendered as an accomplished result.
